parsed.explanation: The quoted line is the conclusion of the main subcase of the lower-bound induction (Theorem B, Case k>=1 with a large piece mu). D_rest is never defined; the claimed identity D_rest = mu - 1 'in the worst case' is asserted, and the parenthetical justification is self-contradictory ('>= mu-1 is impossible because ... would require equality throughout'). The padding step also assumes the padded multiset arises from B_{n-1} by <= n-1 cuts, which is not shown. The second subcase is equally unsupported ('forces the combined D(Q) to be even with respect to the unit lattice ...') and relies on hand/numerical checks for n<=3. Hence no valid all-n lower bound is established anywhere; supplying it requires a new lemma.
